collections.title: Aesthetic Retro Photo Prints
collections.description:
📄 Product Description

Turn your favorite memories into timeless keepsakes with our Custom Retro Photo Prints — beautifully printed on premium glossy paper with a clean white border and optional personalized captions. Whether you're decorating your space, gifting moments to loved ones, or cherishing travel highlights, these prints add the perfect personal touch.

✨ Why You’ll Love It

  • 📸 Upload & Personalize – Just upload your photos and we’ll handle the printing with care
  • ✏️ Optional Captions – Add a meaningful message or quote under each photo
  • 📏 Choose Your Size – Available in 3.5 x 4.2” (classic) or A6 (larger and bolder)
  • 💎 Premium Print Quality – Sharp, vibrant prints on glossy photo paper
  • 🎁 Great for Gifting, Scrapbooks & Decor
  • 🇮🇳 Made in India • Delivered Across India

📦 What’s Included

  • A set of 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 Retro Photo Prints
  • With or without custom captions (as per your selection)
  • Available in two sizes:
    • 🟢 3.5 x 4.2 inch – Compact and aesthetic
    • 🟢 A6 size – Larger with more visual impact

🧠 How It Works

  1. Choose your Quantity (10 to 50 prints)
  2. Select whether you want Captions
  3. Pick your Size (3.5 x 4.2” or A6)
  4. Upload your photos – from your device, Google Drive, or social media
  5. (Optional) Add notes or captions per photo or a single title for the set
  6. Place your order – we’ll print, pack, and deliver with care

🔄 Important Notes

  • If fewer photos are uploaded than selected, we’ll fill remaining prints with aesthetic quote designs
  • Every print includes a classic white Retro Photo Printsborder
  • For bulk orders (above 100 prints), email us for a custom deal

🚚 Shipping Info

  • 📦 Dispatched in 2–3 working days
  • 🛵 Delivered anywhere in India (COD & Prepaid available)
  • 🔍 Track your order anytime via your Posterized account

💬 Need Help?

Email us at support@posterized.in — our team is always happy to help.
